skills.name: estimate-visit-brief
skills.description: Prepare a dispatch brief from confirmed estimate notes. Preserve contact details, visit time and source references.
skills.instructions: Read the supplied visit notes. Extract the customer, appointment and access instructions. Cite the source file next to each fact. If a required fact is absent, list it as missing. Do not infer prices or mark the visit confirmed without an explicit confirmation.
